contribution.value: The C# audit verifies exact selected identity/order, four CLR SHA-256 signatures, numerical limits, two pinned source package identities, independent version layers and no BrokerReady or runtime grants. Reuse existing per-artifact refusal evidence without repeating previous campaigns.
debtChanges: RS194 succeeded attempt 001 after one network preselection refusal; it was not first-pass.
